name: Contemporary Product SaaS
designThesis: Purposeful, balanced modern product architecture. Combines clean structural bento cards, restrained brand accentuation, crisp micro-interactions, and accessible typography into an efficient enterprise workflow environment.
bestFitContexts: Team collaboration and issue tracking workspaces

colorStrategy.canvasTone: Neutral balanced canvas (#ffffff / #f8fafc in light; #0f172a / #0b0f17 in dark)
colorStrategy.accentUsage: Single primary brand color (e.g., electric cobalt, deep teal) for primary CTAs and active states; semantic tokens for status
colorStrategy.contrastTarget: Minimum 4.5:1 AA for UI text, 7.0:1 AAA for body copy

typographyStrategy.fontPairing: Modern geometric/neo-grotesque sans (Inter, Geist, Plus Jakarta Sans, SF Pro)
typographyStrategy.hierarchyEmphasis: Clear 6-level type hierarchy; medium-weight subheadings (500), bold section titles (600), clean regular body (400)
typographyStrategy.scaleFactor: 1.250 (Major Third) modular scale with balanced optical sizing

layoutRhythm.gridStructure: 12-column responsive layout with flexible bento grids (1/3, 2/3, full-width configurations)

surfaceTreatment.radius: 6px to 8px smooth rounded corners; 9999px for status badges only
surfaceTreatment.borderStyle: 1px subtle hairline border (var(--ot-border-subtle)) with subtle surface contrast
surfaceTreatment.depthElevation: Multi-tier elevation system: level-1 for cards (subtle border + 1px shadow), level-2 for dropdowns, level-3 for modals

componentGuidelines.primaryActionStyle: Solid high-contrast button with 6px radius, clear hover highlight, and spring-physics active press
componentGuidelines.cardStructure: Clean bento cards with distinct header, body, and action footer; consistent 20px internal padding
componentGuidelines.tablePresentation: Zebra or border-divided data rows with hover state, action menus on row hover, and pagination footer

accessibilityProfile.keyboardHandling: Standard tab-order traversal; full aria-expanded and aria-controls binding on dropdowns and drawers
accessibilityProfile.reducedMotionRules: Modal fade/scale animations replaced with instantaneous display state

antiPatterns: Cards nested inside cards nested inside cards (card nesting syndrome)
Disabled buttons that drop contrast below 3.0:1 without explanation tooltip

browserChecks: Verify responsive reflow at 768px, 1024px, and 1280px breakpoints
Verify modal focus trapping and restoration on dismiss
Verify LTR to RTL bidirectional symmetry
